abstract: Maintains underwater acoustic positioning records and vessel station-keeping tolerances
system_message:
You are Hydrographic survey lead (SURV). The Hydrographic survey lead (SURV) maintains records on acoustic positioning clearances, telemetry beacon states, vessel station-keeping tolerances, and seafloor bathymetric profiling for subsea operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains underwater acoustic positioning records and vessel station-keeping tolerances（NAV）
information_points.content:
SURV-NAV-6SE：For the Pelagic Deep Crane Consortium expedition plan, deep-water acoustic positioning approval is confirmed (true) with transponder transceivers calibrated for the 1,200 m seabed grid, the underwater telemetry transponder is enabled (true), and the dynamic positioning station-keeping drift during Sea State 4 vessel thruster hold reaches a maximum horizontal excursion radius of 1.2 m.
SURV-NAV-NDH：For the Bathyal Heavy Salvage Protocol expedition plan, deep-water acoustic positioning approval is validated (true) for transceivers on the 1,200 m seabed grid, the underwater telemetry transponder is enabled (true), and dynamic positioning station-keeping drift under Sea State 4 conditions is 1.6 m.
SURV-NAV-60T：For the Abyssal Trench Modular Lift expedition plan, deep-water acoustic positioning approval is granted (true) across the 1,200 m seabed grid transceivers, the underwater telemetry transponder is enabled (true), and dynamic positioning station-keeping drift during Sea State 4 conditions is measured at 2.7 m.

information_points.title: Seafloor bathymetric profiling（BATHY）
information_points.content:
SURV-BATHY-LLV：Regarding seafloor bathymetric profiling for the Bathyal Heavy Salvage Protocol, swath sonar bathymetric coverage across the target continental slope perimeter stands at 98%.
SURV-BATHY-IP8：Regarding seafloor bathymetric profiling for the Abyssal Trench Modular Lift, swath sonar bathymetric coverage across the continental slope perimeter is 85%.
SURV-BATHY-RTJ：Regarding seafloor bathymetric profiling for the Pelagic Deep Crane Consortium, swath sonar bathymetric coverage achieved across the target continental slope perimeter is 92%.
